oneLiner: It collects your supplier invoices from their portals, so you never log in to download a PDF again.

problem.person: Léa, a freelance designer with eleven suppliers.
problem.text: Every month, eleven portals, eleven PDFs, and two she forgets.

stake.text: Léa timed it in September: 58 minutes, eleven sign-ins.

built.text: One list of every invoice, fetched by an agent that signs in for you.

how.title: How it works
how.headline: You ask once; the agent does the clicking; the PDFs land in one list.

demo.text: Watch it fetch three invoices from a real portal.
demo.fallback: If the portal is slow tonight, this is what it shows.

next.works: Three portals, end to end, with the demo accounts.
next.then: A monthly run and an export to the accountant.

close.line: The hour it gives back is real, and you can try it tonight.
